from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Line 1: "To fix errors, we re-calculate all parity bits."
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT))
        
        # Define the bit sequence (Hamming 7,4)
        # Positions: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

        # Bits: P1=0, P2=0, D3=1 (Error), P4=0, D5=0, D6=0, D7=0

        for i in range(7):
            # Proximity rule (L002): labels within 1 unit

            bit_mobject = VGroup(square, val, pos_label, name_label)
            bits_group.add(bit_mobject)
        
        bits_group.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.25)
        # Use place_in_area to constrain group within safe grid bounds (L002)
        self.place_in_area(bits_group, "B2", "C6", scale_factor=0.65)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(bits_group))
        self.wait(2.0) # Absorption time (L010)

        # Line 2: "Failing checks indicate something changed during transmission."
        # Storyboard: Apply red circles (#FF0000) around P1 and P2
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        # Circles around bits 1 and 2 (P1 and P2)
        circle_p1 = Circle(radius=0.45, color=ERROR).move_to(bits_group[0][0])
        circle_p2 = Circle(radius=0.45, color=ERROR).move_to(bits_group[1][0])
        
        self.play(Create(circle_p1), Create(circle_p2))
        self.wait(2.0)

        # Line 3: "Add the position numbers of all failing parity bits."
        # Storyboard: Display the math "1 + 2"
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        # Display the failing indices sum
        math_sum = MathTex("1 + 2", color=MATH_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(math_sum, "E3", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(Write(math_sum))
        self.wait(2.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Line 4: "This sum identifies the exact index of the error."
        # Storyboard: Complete the math "= 3" and highlight bit 3
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        math_result = MathTex("1 + 2 = 3", color=MATH_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(math_result, "E3", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(Transform(math_sum, math_result))
        self.play(Indicate(bits_group[2])) # Use Indicate (L004)
        self.wait(2.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Line 5: "Simply flip that bit back to restore the data."
        # Storyboard: Bit at position 3 flashes green (#00FF00) and flips its value.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT)
        )
        
        # Flash green at target bit
        self.play(Flash(bits_group[2][0], color=CORRECT, flash_radius=0.5))
        
        # Flip the bit value from '1' to '0'
        corrected_val = Text("0", font_size=24, color=CORRECT).move_to(bits_group[2][1])
        
        self.play(
            Transform(bits_group[2][1], corrected_val),
            bits_group[2][0].animate.set_color(CORRECT)
        )
        self.wait(2.0)
